about: Every line Bean speaks, and when. A copy for reading: the app speaks from the source files named in "source", not from this file. {word} is the practice word.

play.when: Kid held still through a Red light (Red Light, Green Light), one at random
says: I did not see a thing!

play.when: Kid moved during a Red light: the game ends
play.says: I saw you move! Game over.

play.when: Kid got closer than the win distance during Red
Say It to Sneak: asking for the first word of the game
play.says: Say your word to sneak closer! Say {word}

play.when: Say It to Sneak: asking for a word after the kid held still

tuningPage.when: Result of each practice Red light
